title: 第十一章 赌坊黑业吃我一刀第十二章 破获窝点继续追踪
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 钱掌柜手拿着一个茶壶，一点都不惧怕。
薛蟠带着贾环来，就是想要今日来销账的，至少把利息给销掉也行。
“钱掌柜，你们的利息太高了，很不合理，之前我没注意，上了你们的当，今日我带我兄弟过来，没别的，只是想要你们能够合理点。”
薛蟠仗着贾环在边上，气焰十足。
钱掌柜一听就明白了，带几个兵就要来让他销利息，这以后要是别人也有样学样，那他赌坊生意还怎么做了？
“诸位，你们要是想来玩几把，我这里随时欢迎，但赌坊的规矩是定死的，一点都不能让。”钱掌柜说道。
贾环此刻才问薛蟠：“到底欠了多少？”
薛蟠也有点不好意思回答。
钱掌柜则是随手从怀中拿出一本账本。
“薛少爷，总共借了一万两，几个月没还，连本带利，两万多两，稍微给你去点零头，那也要算你两万两。”钱掌柜一点点的算。
“屁，哪里有那么多，我没借那么多，到手最多也就八千两。”
“我们这就是这样，借一万，给八千，当时就跟薛少爷说好了，这是头息！”钱掌柜有恃无恐回答。
贾环眉头紧蹙，这确实利息过高了。
但赌坊挣的就是这个钱，所以利息高也正常。
“这样，给我们面子，让薛少找八千两还你们，这笔帐就算销了如何？”
这会是薛蟠理亏在先，贾环觉得欠债还钱，把本金还给他们赌坊也就得了。
岂料眼前这钱掌柜，根本就没把他们放在眼里。
“哼，不行！”钱掌柜毫不犹豫拒绝。
“你，我们头儿给你机会了，你居然还敢拒绝？”马癞生气的指着钱掌柜。
“我们赌坊定的规矩，那是外人几句话就能改的？”钱掌柜依旧不理会。
薛蟠此刻咬着牙，恶狠狠的说道：“好，钱掌柜，是你逼我的！环兄弟，我要举报，他们赌坊还做拐人的买卖。”
薛蟠本不想把赌坊得罪的太死。
但对方不把利息都给自己减掉，自己两万两哪里去找？大不了撕破了脸，谁也别想好过！
而说起拐卖人口一事，他倒也不是空口无凭。
之前有次薛蟠在赌坊中赌到很晚，听到后面有女人的声音，偷偷看过一眼，在一个屋子中看到绑着两个人。
很多赌坊暗中都跟一些其他产业有所联系。
因为他们背后的关系，也没人去查。
“薛少爷，你欠债不还，还敢污蔑我们赌坊？你真真是好不要脸！”
钱掌柜愠怒，起身喝道！
瞧他那一副被戳中软肋，做贼心虚的样，贾环眯了眯眼，暗道这是被薛蟠说中了？
content_en:
Shopkeeper Qian held a teapot in his hand and was not afraid at all.
Xue Pan brought Jia Huan here because he wanted to write off the debt today, at least write off the interest.
"Shop Manager Qian, your interest rates are too high and very unreasonable. I didn't pay attention before and fell into your trap. I brought my brother here today. Nothing else. I just want you to be more reasonable."
Xue Pan, with Jia Huan by his side, was full of arrogance.
Shopkeeper Qian understood it as soon as he heard it, and brought a few soldiers to ask him to sell the interest. If others followed suit in the future, how could he continue his gambling business?
"Everyone, if you want to come and play a few games, I'm always welcome here, but the rules of the gambling house are fixed and you can't give in at all." Shopkeeper Qian said.
Only then did Jia Huan ask Xue Pan: "How much do you owe?"
"Ahem..."
Xue Pan was also a little embarrassed to answer.
Shopkeeper Qian casually took out a ledger from his pocket.
"Master Xue, I borrowed a total of 10,000 taels. I haven't paid it back for several months. With the principal and interest, it's more than 20,000 taels. If I give you a small change, it will also count as your 20,000 taels." Shopkeeper Qian calculated bit by bit.
"Shit, there are so many. I didn't borrow that much. I only got 8,000 taels at most."
"That's what we are doing. We borrow 10,000 and give 8,000. We agreed with Master Xue at that time that this is the first interest!" Shopkeeper Qian replied confidently.
Jia Huan frowned. The interest rate was indeed too high.
But this is the money that gambling houses make, so high interest rates are normal.
"How about giving us face and asking Mr. Xue to find 8,000 taels to pay you back? How about the account being written off?"
This would be Xue Panli's first loss. Jia Huan felt that if he owed money, he could just return the principal to their gambling house.
Unexpectedly, the shopkeeper Qian in front of him didn't take them seriously at all.
"Huh, no!" Shopkeeper Qian refused without hesitation.
"You, our boss gave you a chance, and you still dare to refuse?" Ma Lei pointed at shopkeeper Qian angrily.
"The rules set by our gambling house can be changed by outsiders with just a few words?" Shopkeeper Qian still ignored them.
Xue Pan gritted his teeth at this moment and said viciously: "Okay, Shopkeeper Qian, you forced me! Brother Huan, I want to report that their gambling shop also engages in the business of abducting people."
Xue Pan didn't want to offend the gambling house too much.
But if the other party doesn't deduct all the interest for me, where can I find the 20,000 taels? The worst case scenario would be torn apart, and no one would be able to get over it!
And when it comes to human trafficking, he is not just talking.
One time before, Xue Pan was gambling late at night in a gambling house. He heard a woman's voice behind him, took a sneak peek and saw two people tied up in a room.
Many gambling houses are secretly connected with other industries.
Because of the relationship behind them, no one went to investigate.
"Master Xue, you dare to slander our gambling house without repaying your debts? You are so shameless!"
Shopkeeper Qian got angry, stood up and shouted!
Seeing how he looked like he had been poked into his weak spot and felt guilty as a thief, Jia Huan squinted his eyes and thought to himself, was Xue Pan telling him right?
title_en: Chapter 11 The black business in the gambling house took a stab at me Chapter 12 Cracking the den and continuing to track it
